## DEXSeq Analysis - GSE67333

```{r}
library(DEXSeq) 
library(tidyverse) 
library(BiocParallel)

out_dir_GSE67333 <- file.path("results", "DEXSeqGSE67333") dir.create(out_dir_GSE67333, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Assign pre-loaded objects for this dataset
count_matrix_GSE67333 <- round(as.matrix(isoform_counts_GSE67333))

sample_data_GSE67333 <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(count_matrix_GSE67333),
  condition = factor(metadata_GSE67333$condition, levels = c("Control", "Treatment"))
  # Add batch and confounders
)
```

```{r}
# Match transcript-to-gene mapping with count matrix row order
tx2gene_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_df_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(transcript_id %in% rownames(count_matrix_GSE67333)) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(match(transcript_id, rownames(count_matrix_GSE67333)))
```

```{r}
# Filter out single-isoform genes (cannot test differential usage)
multi_iso_genes_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::count(gene_id) |> 
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) |> 
  dplyr::pull(gene_id)

keep_tx_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333$gene_id %in% multi_iso_genes_GSE67333
count_matrix_GSE67333 <- count_matrix_GSE67333[keep_tx_GSE67333, ]
tx2gene_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333[keep_tx_GSE67333, ]

# Filter out low-count isoforms
keep_expr_GSE67333 <- rowSums(count_matrix_GSE67333 >= 10) >= 3
count_matrix_GSE67333 <- count_matrix_GSE67333[keep_expr_GSE67333, ]
tx2gene_GSE67333 <- tx2gene_GSE67333[keep_expr_GSE67333, ]
```

```{r}
# Build DEXSeqDataSet object
dxd_GSE67333 <- DEXSeqDataSet(
  countData = count_matrix_GSE67333,
  sampleData = sample_data_GSE67333,
  design = ~ sample + exon + condition:exon,
  featureID = tx2gene_GSE67333$transcript_id,
  groupID = tx2gene_GSE67333$gene_id
)
```

```{r}
# Normalization, dispersion estimation, and differential usage testing
dxd_GSE67333 <- estimateSizeFactors(dxd_GSE67333)
dxd_GSE67333 <- estimateDispersions(dxd_GSE67333, BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE67333)
dxd_GSE67333 <- testForDEU(dxd_GSE67333, BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE67333)

# Estimate relative log2 fold changes across conditions
dxd_GSE67333 <- estimateExonFoldChanges(dxd_GSE67333, fitExpToVar = "condition", BPPARAM = BPPARAM_GSE67333)

# Extract results
dxr_GSE67333 <- DEXSeqResults(dxd_GSE67333)
```

```{r}
# Isoform-level results (all and significant at FDR < 0.05)
res_isoforms_GSE67333 <- as.data.frame(dxr_GSE67333) |> 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_isoform") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(padj)

sig_isoforms_GSE67333 <- res_isoforms_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

# Gene-level p-value aggregation (all and significant at FDR < 0.05)
gene_qvals_GSE67333 <- perGeneQValue(dxr_GSE67333)
res_genes_GSE67333 <- data.frame(
  gene_id = names(gene_qvals_GSE67333),
  gene_padj = gene_qvals_GSE67333
) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(gene_padj)

sig_genes_GSE67333 <- res_genes_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_padj), gene_padj < 0.05)

# Save result tables and RDS object to results/DEXSeqGSE67333
readr::write_csv(res_isoforms_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_all_isoforms_GSE67333.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_isoforms_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_sig_isoforms_GSE67333.csv"))
readr::write_csv(res_genes_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_all_genes_GSE67333.csv"))
readr::write_csv(sig_genes_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "DEXSeq_sig_genes_GSE67333.csv"))
saveRDS(dxr_GSE67333, file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "dxr_GSE67333.rds"))
```

```{r}
# Inspect top 10 significant genes
head(res_genes_GSE67333, 10)
```

## Graphs and Analysis

```{r}
# Dispersion estimation plot
plotDispEsts(dxd_GSE67333, main = "DEXSeq - Dispersion Estimation (GSE67333)")
```

```{r}
# MA plot
plotMA(dxr_GSE67333, cex = 0.8, alpha = 0.05, main = "MA Plot - Differential Isoform Usage (GSE67333)")
```

```{r}
# Custom Volcano plot
lfc_col_GSE67333 <- grep("^log2fold_", colnames(res_isoforms_GSE67333), value = TRUE)[1]

volcano_df_GSE67333 <- res_isoforms_GSE67333 |> 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(.data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]])) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]] > 1  ~ "Up (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)",
      padj < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]] < -1 ~ "Down (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

volcano_plot_GSE67333 <- ggplot(volcano_df_GSE67333, aes(x = .data[[lfc_col_GSE67333]], y = -log10(padj), color = sig)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)" = "#D55E00",
    "Down (padj < 0.05 & |LFC| > 1)" = "#0072B2",
    "Not significant" = "grey75"
  )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Differential Isoform Usage - GSE67333",
    x = paste0("Log2 Fold Change (", lfc_col_GSE67333, ")"),
    y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

volcano_plot_GSE67333
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_GSE67333, "volcano_plot_GSE67333.png"), plot = volcano_plot_GSE67333, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Isoform usage profile for the top significant gene
top_gene_GSE67333 <- res_genes_GSE67333$gene_id[1]

plotDEXSeq(
  dxr_GSE67333,
  geneID = top_gene_GSE67333,
  fitExpToVar = "condition",
  splicing = TRUE,           # Removes overall gene expression changes to isolate isoform proportions
  displayTranscripts = TRUE, # Displays transcript structures below the plot
  names = TRUE,
  legend = TRUE,
  cex.axis = 1.1,
  cex = 1.2,
  main = paste("Isoform Switching (GSE67333):", top_gene_GSE67333)
)
```
